title: Russian Pudding Cheesecake
description: A rich and creamy Russian-inspired dessert featuring a velvety pudding cheesecake topped with a quenched curd mixture.
instructions: Prepare the Russian panna cotta pudding mix according to package instructions.
In a separate bowl, beat the cream cheese until smooth.
Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Gradually add granulated sugar and beat until combined.
Pour the pudding mixture into a greased 9-inch springform pan.
Bake for 45-50 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Allow the cheesecake to cool completely.
Prepare the curd mixture by beating the curd cheese until smooth.
Add melted butter, heavy cream, and confectioners' sugar. Beat until combined.
Spread the curd mixture over the cooled cheesecake.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours before serving.
